const kpis = $json.data || $json;
return [{
  json: {
    syncedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    totalLeads: kpis.totalLeads,
    sentLeads: kpis.sentLeads,
    visits: kpis.visits,
    consents: kpis.consents,
    forms: kpis.forms,
    qualified: kpis.qualified,
    routed: kpis.routed,
    delivered: kpis.delivered,
    deliveryFailed: kpis.deliveryFailed,
    visitRate: kpis.conversionRates?.visitRate,
    consentRate: kpis.conversionRates?.consentRate,
    formRate: kpis.conversionRates?.formRate,
    qualificationRate: kpis.conversionRates?.qualificationRate,
    deliveryRate: kpis.conversionRates?.deliveryRate,
    estimatedRevenueCents: kpis.revenue?.estimatedRevenueCents,
    payoutCents: kpis.revenue?.payoutCents,
    byStatus: JSON.stringify(kpis.byStatus || {}),
    byDeliveryStatus: JSON.stringify(kpis.byDeliveryStatus || {}),
    byBatch: JSON.stringify(kpis.byBatch || []),
    byPartner: JSON.stringify(kpis.byPartner || []),
    auditEvents: JSON.stringify(kpis.auditEvents || {})
  }
}];
